summary: Implemented the sf1 (Sapience terminal chat) Neovim integration as a lazy.nvim virtual plugin at lua/neotex/plugins/ai/sapience-plugin.lua, with a dependency-free sapience/ implementation directory (terminal.lua window backend, init.lua public API with opts validation, --project resolution, and a live set_position reposition). Registered :Sf1 and <leader>af, added an is_sf1 branch to the shared terminal-keymap function, and wrote module/parent README and MAPPINGS.md documentation. All six plan phases completed and committed individually; the full verify-deploy.sh gate set surfaced 5 pre-existing, unrelated failures (core-extension deploy staleness and repo-wide lint findings) that were attributed and logged via issue-record.sh rather than repaired, per the plan's explicit scope.

completion_data.completion_summary: Built the sf1 Sapience terminal chat Neovim integration as a lazy.nvim virtual plugin (sapience-plugin.lua + sapience/{init,terminal}.lua), with position/size configuration, :Sf1 toggle, <leader>af keymap, and an is_sf1 terminal-keymap branch. All six plan phases completed and verified; sf1 and Claude Code can coexist since no picker integration was added, per the task's explicit prohibition.
